definitions.explanation: Something that has just arrived or been added. Commonly used for new merchandise, email messages, news, or website content.

examples.japanese: {新着|しんちゃく}メールを{確認|かくにん}する。
{新着|しんちゃく}{商品|しょうひん}がたくさん{入荷|にゅうか}した。
examples.english: Many new products have arrived in stock.

examples.japanese: サイトの{新着|しんちゃく}{情報|じょうほう}を{毎朝|まいあさ}チェックするのが{日課|にっか}になっている。
examples.english: Checking the site's latest updates every morning has become my daily routine.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a noun modifier (の-type) in compounds. Very common in online contexts ({新着|しんちゃく}メール, {新着|しんちゃく}{通知|つうち}) and retail ({新着|しんちゃく}{商品|しょうひん}). Functions as a pre-noun modifier without の in many set compounds.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新着|しんちゃく}メール: new email
- {新着|しんちゃく}{情報|じょうほう}: latest information/updates
- {新着|しんちゃく}{商品|しょうひん}: new arrivals (products)
- {新着|しんちゃく}{通知|つうち}: new notification
- {新着|しんちゃく}{順|じゅん}: in order of newest first
